paper_title: Can LLMs Solve longer Math Word Problems Better
caption: : Caption not extracted
model_annotation: The line plot illustrates the performance of two models—labeled "w.o. extension" (blue dashed line with circular markers) and "extension" (orange solid line with triangular markers)—in terms of missing step accuracy across four different conditions, represented along the x-axis. The y-axis, labeled "Missing Step," measures the proportion of missing steps, ranging from 0.840 to 0.860. Both lines show a decreasing trend, indicating improved performance as the condition number increases. At condition 0, the "w.o. extension" model starts at approximately 0.860, while the "extension" model begins slightly lower at around 0.859. By condition 4, the "w.o. extension" model reaches a value of approximately 0.839, and the "extension" model reaches approximately 0.842. The "extension" model consistently maintains a higher missing step accuracy than the "w.o. extension" model across all conditions, with the gap between the two models widening as the condition number increases.
